value.name: Asha notices Whitfield's trembling hand
value.description: Asha deliberately studies Whitfield's hand on the intake page and notices the faint tremor he is trying to control.
evidence: let her gaze drop the inch it took to find Whitfield's hand on the corner of the intake page
the pad of his index finger was no longer flat against the paper; it had lifted just enough that she could see the faint tremor where it hovered

value.name: Asha withholds a response
value.description: Asha refuses to blink, speak, or move, choosing silence to force Whitfield to confront the tension between them.
evidence: She kept her eyes on the hinge of his jaw and then on that fingertip and refused to give him the relief of a sound or a shifted foot
she had decided in the hallway that she would not be the one to fill the gap she had come here to name

value.name: Whitfield stops pressing harder
value.description: Whitfield's control slips as he stops pressing his finger harder against the paper, and the room remains tense and silent.
evidence: the kind of tremor a man controls by pressing harder, which he had stopped doing
The radiator did not tick again, and the four-eighteen stamp sat where she had placed it, and Whitfield's hand, when it finally moved, moved toward the page rather than away from it

value.name: Whitfield remains silent
value.description: Whitfield settles his finger back on the page but still does not speak, prolonging the standoff with Asha.
evidence: Whitfield's finger settled flat to the page again, but he still did not speak

value.name: Asha retrieves the Hatcher file materials
value.description: Asha moves to the cabinet by Whitfield's window and takes the trial record and intake log from the Hatcher working file without asking.
evidence: When she did move, it was sideways to the low cabinet beside his window, where the Hatcher working file lived in the third drawer
she drew out the trial record and the intake log without asking

value.name: Asha places records beside Whitfield's page
value.description: Asha sets the retrieved records on the blotter next to Whitfield's page, asserting control over the documents in front of him.
evidence: and set them on the blotter beside the page he had not yet released

value.name: Asha aligns the documents
value.description: Asha carefully squares the corners of the papers against the desk edge, reinforcing her deliberate, controlled stance.
evidence: She aligned the corners against the edge of the desk
